2608.25398.title: OmniPhys: A Unified Multimodal Benchmark for Physics Understanding and Generation from Chinese Educational Corpora
2608.25398.paper_summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong abilities in solving diverse visual and textual reasoning tasks. However, their development in the physics domain is significantly hindered by the lack of a comprehensive benchmark. To fill this gap, we introduce OmniPhys, a large-scale benchmark for multimodal physics understanding and reasoning, covering middle school through university-level problems from Chinese Educational Corpora. OmniPhys consists of 15,246 questions and 19,850 images, accompanied by detailed annotations that support fine-grained analysis of reasoning processes and knowledge usage. Beyond conventional evaluation, OmniPhys is a benchmark that systematically evaluates multimodal outputs in the physics domain, including models' ability to generate structured physics diagrams, which constitute a fundamental component of authentic physics problem solving. Extensive evaluations reveal critical gaps in the capabilities of current MLLMs, especially in complex reasoning and visual generation. To address this, we release OmniPhys to serve as a foundational resource for advancing multimodal intelligence in physics and scientific domains. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/ECNU-RAIL/OmniPhys-EMNLP2026.
2608.25398.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）在解決多樣的視覺和文本推理任務方面展現了強大的能力。<lb/>然而，它們在物理領域的發展受到全面基準缺乏的顯著阻礙。<lb/>為填補這一空白，我們推出了 OmniPhys，一個大規模的多模態物理理解與推理基準，涵蓋從中學到大學水平的問題，來自中國教育語料庫。<lb/>OmniPhys 包含 15,246 道問題和 19,850 張圖片，並附有詳細的註釋，支持對推理過程和知識使用的細緻分析。<lb/>超越傳統評估，OmniPhys 是一個系統性評估物理領域多模態輸出的基準，包括模型生成結構化物理圖的能力，這是解決真實物理問題的基本組成部分。<lb/>廣泛的評估顯示當前 MLLMs 在複雜推理和視覺生成方面存在關鍵差距。<lb/>為了解決這一問題，我們發布了 OmniPhys，以作為推進物理和科學領域多模態智能的基礎資源。<lb/>代碼和數據可在 https://github.com/ECNU-RAIL/OmniPhys-EMNLP2026 獲得。
